Subject: Re: Contract cadence and short-term remit request

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the chat last week. Quick recap from our side: Mediora can commit to the pilot but our treasury is stretched this quarter due to an unexpected receivables lag. We need to request a temporary push to Net60 for initial billing, with a staged repayment plan (two milestone invoices to be paid within the following 90 days).

We are prepared to provide:
- A 25% security deposit up front (wire or card)
- Monthly remittance notifications and a statement of funds
- VAT evidence for our UK entity (Priya is copied)

Can you share a concrete payment matrix and any contract language you’d need for a 60-day pilot? We want this to be timeboxed and reversible.

— Adam

Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Liquid-remit framework, staged invoicing & VAT allocation (simulation attached)

Adam —

Thanks for the clear ask. We’re open to a timeboxed Net60 pilot with conditions that protect both sides. I’ve attached a simulation matrix (liquid-remit-scenario-matrix.xlsx) that shows three options:

A) 60-day single invoice with 25% deposit + monthly covenant reporting
B) Two milestone invoices (30d + 60d) with 15% deposit and conditional early-pay credit
C) Net30 for usage above a threshold, Net60 for initial onboarding tranche (hybrid)

For VAT: we need the VAT registration evidence for the UK/EEA entity (the pdf attached summarizes what our tax team needs). If Priya can confirm the docs, we can avoid a withholding.

Non-negotiables:
- Pilot capped at $250k of billable usage
- Auto-reversion to Net30 if covenants are missed twice in a rolling 90-day window
- Redwood to receive the deposit before first invoice issuance

Karthik will outline the contract amendment language and our collections triggers. Monica will own the operational onboarding and will coordinate invoice flow.

Can you confirm by EOD Thursday (8/27) so we can route a signature-ready amendment?

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Liquid-remit framework, staged invoicing & VAT allocation (simulation attached)

Adam —

Following up with the proposed amendment language. Key clauses we’d insert:
- Term: 90-day pilot starting on first invoice date
- Payment terms: Net60 for Pilot Tranche 1 (capped $150k), Net30 thereafter for ongoing usage
- Security: 25% refundable deposit applied to final invoice; deposit held in escrow if mutually agreed
- Reporting: Monthly usage + payment covenant statement due within 10 business days of month-end
- Reversion: Automatic reversion to standard Net30 upon two covenant misses in 90 days
- VAT: Customer confirms liability; Redwood reserves right to withhold taxes if valid VAT evidence not provided within 14 days

I’ve dropped a few optional toggles in the attached doc for signature. If you want, we can convert the deposit to a letter-of-credit (LOC) instead of a cash deposit — that typically helps larger customers avoid balance-sheet hits.

If agreed, Hannah will issue a signature-ready amendment and Monica will update the invoice routing.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
